cues.text: Environmental Health Department, Paul speaking.
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: Oh, hello. Erm, wanted to report a vehicle that's been left parked near where I live - I think it’s been abandoned, I wondered if the council could arrange to get it towed away Have I got through to the right department?
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Yes. you have. If I could just take a few details . your name, please?
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: Mrs Shefford.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Thank you
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: It's not my vehicle, though .. I just thought someone ought to report it
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: No. that’s fine. What I need to do is take some details first, then we can decide what to do about the problem.
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: Oh, I see.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: So the next thing l need to know is your address
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: Right It’s 41 Lower Green Street.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Yes
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: Barrowdale. And the post code's WH4 5JP.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Fine And if I could just ask for a telephone number ?
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: It's 01778 552387 I’m out quite a lot, but you can just leave a message on the answer phone if you need to or I could give you my mobile number?
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: That’s all right, don’t worry Now. could you tell me a little more about this vehicle You say it’s been abandoned?
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: Well, it certainly looks like it.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Can you give me an idea of where it is?
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: Yes. It's near the main road that goes through Barrowdale.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Is that the A69?
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: Yes. That's right Now. there's the primary school just towards the end of the village, and then next to that, next to the children's playground, there’s a field, and it’s in there.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Aah ... I wonder how it got in there?
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: There's a gate to allow farm machinery in and out l thought something ought to be done about it - the children from the school might start playing in the vehicle and lock themselves in or something
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Yes, you were quite right to report it. And what type of vehicle are we talking about here?
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: It's a van actually. You know, the sort with just a couple of little windows at the back.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Right You don't happen to know the make and model, do you?
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: Oh. yes I went and had a look and got all the details. I thought you might need them I’m surprised the school hasn’t contacted you about it Anyway. I wrote the details down Er. right, it's a Catala, and the model’s a  Flyer 2000.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Is that F-L-Y-E-R?
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: That’s right.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Very good. And the colour?
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: Well, it’s not all that easy to see because it’s absolutely filthy. And actually, it looks as if it’s had a paint job at some stage .. it’s blue, but you can just see white underneath where it’s been scratched.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Right Well, I'll just make a note of the present colour. And if you could just tell me the vehicle number. Did you make a note of that?
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: Oh, yes. It’s S 322 GEC.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: OK.
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: And it sounds as if the general condition of the vehicle isn’t too good, from what you say.
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: No, it’s pretty poor. It wouldn’t be drivable. It’s got a flat tyre, and there's a crack in the windscreen I reckon someone just wanted to get rid of it.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: That's usually the way.
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: It's been there for nearly a week . no. it must be eight days. I remember it was a Sunday morning when l noticed it. It wasn't there the day before. I walk past it most days on the way to the shops I'd have thought the school would have reported it.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Does the field actually belong to the school?
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: No, it’s part of Hill Farm Estate.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Right! It just make a note of that. And I don't suppose you have any information about who might own the vehicle?
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: No, I’ve no idea. So what will you do now?
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Well, we’ll come and have a look, and see if we can trace the owner. And if we can't, the vehicle will be removed as rapidly as the law permits. It could be anything up to 20 days.
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: One thing I should say, I'm quite sure this doesn't belong to anyone round here I'd definitely recognise it if it was from someone who lived here.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: So you don't think it was anyone local. Right, I'd say at a guess we're looking at a stolen vehicle here.
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: I did wonder if it might have been. You hear such a lot about car thieves nowadays.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Well, we certain!y will be looking into that possibility. Anyway, thank you for contacting us, Mrs Shefford, and we'll keep you informed of what happens.
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: Right. Thank you very much.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford

cues.text: Goodbye.
cues.speaker: Council Officer

cues.text: Goodbye.
cues.speaker: Mrs Shefford
